title: Proposition 1.1: local L2 almost-periodicity of finite-set convolutions on arbitrary groups
statement_scope: Let G be a group, let A, B ⊂ G be finite subsets, let ε ∈ (0,1) be a parameter, and suppose S ⊂ G satisfies |B·S| ≤ K|B|. Then there is T ⊂ S with |T| ≥ |S|/(2K)^(9/ε^2) such that, for each t ∈ T T^{-1}, ||1_A*1_B(xt)-1_A*1_B(x)||_2^2 ≤ ε^2 |A| |B|^2.
